lines.trans: I never expected Mr Chun Yuqiao to shut me out like this.
I had already prepared myself to accept whatever reaction he might have toward me.
You may be overthinking it; perhaps he is simply in a bad mood after resigning.
Yet today I saw him having tea with Mr Wen Simo, and he looked genuinely happy.
What matters is that he never truly liked me at all, right?
Enough heartbreak reporting—let us talk business.
We can produce the data report you asked for, though it depends on how much effort goes in.
As long as it helps Rong Silun, name whatever price you want.
This is the price, no haggling; since you need it urgently, I will get started right now.
The results are in, and Rong Silun really is the undisputed first choice across the internet.
Wonderful, I really hope he gets to star in Princess Qingcheng too.
Growing up comes at a price, and you may still need a bit more courage.

examples.text: 看到方案通过，大家都特别高兴。
